questions.prompt: Why were the Pharisees and scribes grumbling? (v2)
options: Jesus welcomed sinners and ate with them
Jesus did not wash before the meal
Jesus taught in the temple courts

questions.prompt: What does the shepherd do when he finds the sheep? (v5)
options: Leads it back to the flock with a rope
Scolds it and keeps it penned
Puts it on his shoulders, rejoicing

questions.prompt: Who does the woman call together when she finds the coin? (v9)

grumble.intro: Be honest. Nobody can see your answer.

scenarios.text: A colleague who did you over in a deal becomes a Christian. Six months later he's asked to give his testimony at church.
A neighbour who fought your renovation through council joins your Bible study.
Someone who left church for 20 years comes back and everyone makes a fuss of them. You've been on the roster the whole time.
A celebrity famous for outrageous behaviour announces they've found Jesus.
A relative who borrowed $5,000 and never paid it back comes to faith. Now they're the most generous giver at church.
